_note: This file supplies the description column of my/MY_INDEX.md.
Keys are paths relative to the project root.
⚠️ The file list is produced by a program (tool_my_index.py); ⛔ the descriptions are
written here by a person or an AI. Why they are separate: code cannot extract
anything meaningful from .docx / .pdf / .xlsx, ⛔ and an index whose description
is the filename has no descriptions at all.
⚠️ A new file does not need a description first — it appears under
'not yet described' in the index and ⛔ is never hidden.
⚠️ Keys starting with an underscore (like this one) do not enter the index.
PROJECT.md: **The one file you fill in yourself**: what this project is, whether it is worth doing, ethical lines, the AI's write permissions.
NEXT_SESSION_MEMO.md: Working state. **Overwritten each round**, ⛔ never appended. The only place in the project allowed to hold 'current progress'.
governance_config.json: **Permission settings**: where the AI does not write, and each role's scope. ⛔ Never replaced by an upgrade.
ledgers/Claim_Ledger.md: **Claim ledger**: which sentence rests on which passage. Spec in `governance/CLAIM_LEDGER_SPEC.md`.
ledgers/Conjecture_Ledger.md: **Conjecture ledger**: the single source of truth for theoretical claims. Spec in `governance/CONJECTURE_LEDGER_SPEC.md`.
corpus/READ_ME.md: How to use `corpus/`: put the PDFs you cite here, one file per paper.
corpus/BIBLIOGRAPHY.docx: **This project's citation-format authority.** Export from Zotero/EndNote and paste it in.
corpus_md/READ_ME.txt: How to use `corpus_md/`: programmatic full-text extractions, ⛔ never hand-edited.
handoffs/README.txt: How to use `handoffs/`: handoff packets go here, append-only.
my/README.txt: How to use `my/`: everything in this folder is yours and is never replaced by an upgrade.
my/MY_RULES.md: **Your working rules.** §1 is a verbatim copy of the framework's rules; §2 holds your own `P-xx`.
my/MY_INCIDENTS.md: **What actually happened in this project**, and your own failure families.
my/tools/README.txt: How to use `my/tools/`: your own scripts go here, ⛔ never in `scripts/`.
.gitignore: What stays out of version control. ⚠️ **Mixed ownership**: the framework supplies defaults, you add to them.
.gitattributes: git's line-ending and binary rules. ⚠️ Same — **mixed ownership**.
my/MY_INDEX_notes.json: **This file**: the source of the description column in `my/MY_INDEX.md`. ⚠️ The index is generated; the descriptions are written here.
